description: Asks to send a copy of every email arriving on the signed-in user's aliases to an https:// webhook URL. Nothing changes yet: the user gets a confirmation email and the webhook is set only after they confirm it there. Tell the user to check their inbox.

url.description: The https:// URL that should receive a copy of every incoming email, for example "https://hooks.example.com/hidemail".

name: request_webhook
title: Request webhook
